sources.title: Google reveals its most realistic world model yet
Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering

cards.summary: Genie 4 can maintain a consistent scene for up to two minutes, double Genie 3's limit, and offers better physics and more humanlike characters.

sources.title: Chrome’s enhanced autofill can now pull info from Gmail to help you fill out forms

cards.summary: Starting today, Chrome's enhanced autofill will use Gemini with Personal Intelligence to suggest information sourced from your Gmail, potentially saving you from having to search for confirmation emails, receipts, or shipping updates yourself.
cards.title: Chrome’s enhanced autofill can now pull info from Gmail to help you fill out forms

sources.title: Meta quietly launched an ‘AI pet journal’ app

cards.summary: Meta has launched a "tamagotchi-style" pet game called Waddle World, with virtual creatures that chat with users and create doodles to illustrate conversations. According to its Apple and Play Store listings, the "16-bit pet care game" is not really a game, but "a daily journal disguised as a pet." Users should talk, not type, with their pets, the description says, as well as play "cozy games" like stacking groceries or word games.
cards.title: Meta quietly launched an ‘AI pet journal’ app

cards.summary: The autofill update lets Chrome pull flight confirmations, tracking info, order details, and other information from your inbox, with your permission.
cards.title: Chrome’s AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms

sources.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model

cards.summary: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.
cards.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model

sources.title: Firefox’s Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring

cards.summary: Mozilla is updating Smart Window - Firefox's AI-powered browsing experience - with a new feature that can help you fill out online forms based on your open tabs. As an example, Mozilla says Smart Window can pull information from your online portfolio or LinkedIn page to paste your work history into a job application.
cards.title: Firefox’s Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring
